title: Ranazjar Isle
wikitext:
[[Image:Ranazjar Isle.jpg|thumb|Ranazjar Isle]]
'''Ranazjar Isle''' is a small, rocky island off the northwest coast of [[Desolace]]{{coords|28|8|Desolace}}. It is inhabited by the serpentine [[naga]]. On the isle are many [[night elven]] ruins that seem to be part of the same ancient city as those of [[Ethel Rethor]]. One notable feature on the island is a statue of what may be [[Queen Azshara]].
